title: The Thawing Spirit Pill Prescription
summary: Xiao Yan wakes at the Alchemist Association, and an attendant called Xun Er leads him to Fa Ma's study. Fa Ma gives him the prize, the Sixth-Tier prescription for the Thawing Spirit Pill, and the badge of an honorary elder of the association. On the way out, Medusa takes over the Heaven Swallowing Python's body and demands the prescription. Xiao Yan says he is not yet a fourth-tier alchemist, but he promises to refine the pill soon. He finds a farewell letter from Xiao Zhan, who has already left the capital. Nalan Yanran returns to the Misty Cloud Sect, where Elder Yun Leng has invited the empire's great forces to watch her duel with Xiao Yan. The episode then goes back years to the capital, where the child Nalan Yanran fights Mu Zhan's gang and Xiao Zhan brings the young Xiao Yan to visit Nalan Jie.
events: Xiao Yan wakes; an association attendant named Xun Er guides him to Chairman Fa Ma.
Nalan Jie, recovered, sends Nalan Yanran back to the Misty Cloud Sect.
Fa Ma gives Xiao Yan the Thawing Spirit Pill prescription (Sixth-Tier) and an honorary elder's badge.
Medusa emerges, having subdued the python's soul, and demands the prescription; Xiao Yan asks for time.
Xiao Yan reads Xiao Zhan's farewell letter.
At the Misty Cloud Sect, Yun Leng tells Nalan Yanran he has invited the empire's forces to the duel.
Flashback: young Nalan Yanran fights Mu Zhan's gang; Xiao Zhan and the young Xiao Yan visit Nalan Jie.
